note.question: How does channel members’ adoption of BBP affect wholesale and retail prices, profits, consumer surplus, and social welfare?
note.overview: With behavior-based pricing (BBP), firms use customers’ purchase history data to price discriminate between past and new customers. Prior research has examined BBP in a non-channel setting. In this paper, we investigate BBP in a channel setting in which manufacturers sell to customers through exclusive retailers.
